 Singrore - Advocate for the petitioner.

Shri Amit Pandey - Government Advocate for respondent
 Order
This is first application under Section 482 of BNSS for grant of anticipatory bail.
The applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.135/2025 registered by Police Station - Seoni, District Seoni (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 420 of IPC.
It is submitted that he has been falsely implicated in the case and has not committed any offence in any manner.
The applicant is the first offender.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering his application for grant of bail.
On these grounds, he has prayed for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.
Per contra, counsel appearing for the State has vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:22024 2 MCRC-20875-2025

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, subject to verification of the fact that the applicant is the first offender, this Court deems it appropriate to allow this anticipatory bail application.

In the event of arrest, applicant Mohammad Salim is directed to be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond Mohammad Salim vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178047221/
1 in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of Arresting Officer.
